knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson cites official pages that set the WP licence threshold at 11 metres for the states named. The rule is state-specific and must be checked for the state where the work is done.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a state and boom length and the candidate states which rule applies and where the source says so
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. Completing the add-on grants no licence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor note on any licence or authority claim made by the candidate
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate applies the 11 metre figure to a state the lesson does not cover
